name.description: The package's folder and name: lower-case words joined by dashes. `queue-tools` creates packages/queue-tools as @avero/queue-tools.

type.description: What the package is for. This decides which packages may import it.

runtime.description: `node` for code that needs Node.js (files, processes, databases). `browser` for code that is safe to ship to a browser.

dependencies.description: Other workspace packages it uses, comma separated, for example `contracts,security`.

tests.description: Set up Vitest and add a first test that checks the package loads.
